executivePulse.interpretation: The situation in memory and AI infrastructure remains strained. Server DRAM / RDIMM, HBM and enterprise SSDs are currently among the most pressured areas. The Daily Check of 2026-08-29 reviewed eight relevant items; it does not indicate any confirmed material change in direction. New capacity and improved yields can relieve pressure but will reach the market only with a time lag. For buyers, supply assurance, alternative BOMs and early procurement remain critical.
